verses.arabicText: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iq'taraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatim-muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: ˹The time of˺ people’s judgment has drawn near, yet they are heedlessly turning away

verses.arabicText: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā yatīhim min dhik'rim-min rabbihim muḥ'dathin illā is'tamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūn
verses.translation: Whatever new reminder comes to them from their Lord, they only listen to it jokingly

verses.arabicText: لَاهِيَةًۭ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lāhiyatan qulūbuhum wa-asarrū n-najwā alladhīna ẓalamū hal hādhā illā basharum-mith'lukum afatatūna s-siḥ'ra wa-antum tub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: with their hearts ˹totally˺ distracted. The evildoers would converse secretly, ˹saying,˺ “Is this ˹one˺ not human like yourselves? Would you fall for ˹this˺ witchcraft, even though you can ˹clearly˺ see?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbī yaʿlamu l-qawla fī s-samāi wal-arḍi wahuwa s-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: The Prophet responded, “My Lord ˹fully˺ knows every word spoken in the heavens and the earth. For He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”

verses.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmin bali if'tarāhu bal huwa shāʿirun falyatinā biāyatin kamā ur'sila l-awalūn
verses.translation: Yet they say, “This ˹Quran˺ is a set of confused dreams! No, he has fabricated it! No, he must be a poet! So let him bring us a ˹tangible˺ sign like those ˹prophets˺ sent before.”

verses.arabicText: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā afahum yu'minūn
verses.translation: Not a ˹single˺ society We destroyed before them ever believed ˹after receiving the signs˺. Will these ˹pagans˺ then believe

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan-nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla dh-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūn
verses.translation: We did not send ˹messengers˺ before you ˹O Prophet˺ except mere men inspired by Us. If you ˹polytheists˺ do not know ˹this already˺, then ask those who have knowledge ˹of the Scriptures˺

verses.arabicText: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadal-lā yakulūna ṭ-ṭaʿāma wamā kānū khālidīn
verses.translation: We did not give those messengers ˹supernatural˺ bodies that did not need food, nor were they immortal

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma ṣadaqnāhumu l-waʿda fa-anjaynāhum waman-nashāu wa-ahlaknā l-mus'rifīn
verses.translation: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, saving them along with whoever We willed and destroying the transgressors

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad anzalnā ilaykum kitāban fīhi dhik'rukum afalā taʿqilūn
verses.translation: We have surely revealed to you a Book, in which there is glory for you. Will you not then understand

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wakam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimataw-wa-anshanā baʿdahā qawman ākharīn
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies of wrongdoers We have destroyed, raising up other people after them

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā aḥassū basanā idhā hum min'hā yarkuḍūn
verses.translation: When the wrongdoers sensed ˹the arrival of˺ Our torment, they started to run away from their cities

verses.arabicText: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā tarkuḍū wa-ir'jiʿū ilā mā ut'rif'tum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tus'alūn
verses.translation: ˹They were told,˺ “Do not run away! Return to your luxuries and your homes, so you may be questioned ˹about your fate˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.translation: They cried, “Woe to us! We have surely been wrongdoers.”

verses.arabicText: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā zālat til'ka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīn
verses.translation: They kept repeating their cry until We mowed them down, ˹leaving them˺ lifeless

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqnā s-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport

verses.arabicText: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Law aradnā an-nattakhidha lahwal-la-ittakhadhnāhu mil-ladunnā in kunnā fāʿilīn
verses.translation: Had We intended to take ˹some˺ amusement, We could have found it in Our presence, if that had been Our Will

verses.arabicText: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal naqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿalā l-bāṭili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhā huwa zāhiquw-walakumu l-waylu mimmā taṣifūn
verses.translation: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, leaving it crushed, and it quickly vanishes. And woe be to you for what you claim

verses.arabicText: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walahu man fī s-samāwāti wal-arḍi waman ʿindahu lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi walā yastaḥsirūn
verses.translation: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those nearest to Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they tire

verses.arabicText: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yusabbiḥūna al-layla wal-nahāra lā yafturūn
verses.translation: They glorify ˹Him˺ day and night, never wavering

verses.arabicText: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ami ittakhadhū ālihatam-mina l-arḍi hum yunshirūn
verses.translation: Or have they taken gods from the earth, who can raise the dead

verses.arabicText: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Law kāna fīhimā ālihatun illā l-lahu lafasadatā fasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.translation: Had there been other gods besides Allah in the heavens or the earth, both ˹realms˺ would have surely been corrupted. So Glorified is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim

verses.arabicText: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yus'alu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yus'alūn
verses.translation: He cannot be questioned about what He does, but they will ˹all˺ be questioned

verses.arabicText: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan qul hātū bur'hānakum hādhā dhik'ru mam-maʿiya wadhik'ru man qablī bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna l-ḥaqa fahum muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Show ˹me˺ your proof. Here is ˹the Quran,˺ the Reminder for those with me; along with ˹earlier Scriptures,˺ the Reminder for those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā arsalnā min qablika mir-rasūlin illā nūḥī ilayhi annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'budūn
verses.translation: We never sent a messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺ without revealing to him: “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so worship Me ˹alone˺.”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū ittakhadha r-raḥmānu waladan sub'ḥānahu bal ʿibādum-muk'ramūn
verses.translation: And they say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring!” Glory be to Him! In fact, those ˹angels˺ are only ˹His˺ honoured servants

verses.arabicText: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yasbiqūnahu bil-qawli wahum bi-amrihi yaʿmalūn
verses.translation: who do not speak until He has spoken, ˹only˺ acting at His command

verses.arabicText: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna illā limani ir'taḍā wahum min khashyatihi mush'fiqūn
verses.translation: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. They do not intercede except for whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamay-yaqul min'hum innī ilāhum-min dūnihi fadhālika najzīhi jahannama kadhālika najzī ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: Whoever of them were to say, “I am a god besides Him,” they would be rewarded with Hell by Us. This is how We reward the wrongdoers

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yara alladhīna kafarū anna s-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā wajaʿalnā mina l-māi kulla shayin ḥayyin afalā yu'minūn
verses.translation: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and earth were ˹once˺ one mass then We split them apart? And We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulal-laʿallahum yahtadūn
verses.translation: And We have placed firm mountains upon the earth so it does not shake with them, and made in it broad pathways so they may find their way

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًۭا مَّحْفُوظًۭا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnā s-samāa saqfam-maḥfūẓan wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, still they turn away from its signs

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī khalaqa al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fī falakiy-yasbaḥūn
verses.translation: And He is the One Who created the day and the night, the sun and the moon—each travelling in an orbit

verses.arabicText: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā jaʿalnā libasharim-min qablika l-khul'da afa-im-mitta fahumu l-khālidūn
verses.translation: We have not granted immortality to any human before you ˹O Prophet˺: so if you die, will they live forever

verses.arabicText: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wanablūkum bil-shari wal-khayri fit'nataw-wa-ilaynā tur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: Every soul will taste death. And We test you ˹O humanity˺ with good and evil as a trial, then to Us you will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā raāka alladhīna kafarū iy-yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī yadhkuru ālihatakum wahum bidhik'ri r-raḥmāni hum kāfirūn
verses.translation: When the disbelievers see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one who speaks ˹ill˺ of your gods?” while they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍۢ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Khuliqa l-insānu min ʿajalin sa-urīkum āyātī falā tastaʿjilūn
verses.translation: Humankind is made of haste. I will soon show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them

verses.arabicText: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: They ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass if what you say is true?”

verses.arabicText: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Law yaʿlamu alladhīna kafarū ḥīna lā yakuffūna ʿaw-wujūhihimu n-nāra walā ʿan ẓuhūrihim walā hum yunṣarūn
verses.translation: If only the disbelievers knew that a time will come when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces or backs, nor will they be helped

verses.arabicText: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةًۭ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal tatīhim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falā yastaṭīʿūna raddahā walā hum yunẓarūn
verses.translation: In fact, the Hour will take them by surprise, leaving them stunned. So they will not be able to avert it, nor will it be delayed from them

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqadi us'tuh'zi-a birusulim-min qablika faḥāqa bi-alladhīna sakhirū min'hum mā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.translation: ˹Other˺ messengers had already been ridiculed before you ˹O Prophet˺, but those who mocked them were overtaken by what they used to ridicule

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul may-yakla-ukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri mina r-raḥmāni bal hum ʿan dhik'ri rabbihim muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: Ask ˹them, O Prophet,˺ “Who can defend you by day or by night against the Most Compassionate?” Still they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌۭ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum ālihatun tamnaʿuhum min dūninā lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra anfusihim walā hum minnā yuṣ'ḥabūn
verses.translation: Or do they have gods—other than Us—that can protect them? They cannot ˹even˺ protect themselves, nor will they be aided against Us

verses.arabicText: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal mattaʿnā hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimu l-ʿumuru afalā yarawna annā natī l-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā afahumu l-ghālibūn
verses.translation: In fact, We have allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers for such a long time ˹that they took it for granted˺. Do they not see that We gradually reduce ˹their˺ land from its borders? Is it they who will then prevail

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā undhirukum bil-waḥyi walā yasmaʿu ṣ-ṣumu d-duʿāa idhā mā yundharūn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I warn you only by revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned

verses.arabicText: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌۭ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wala-im-massathum nafḥatum-min ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.translation: If they were touched by even a breath of your Lord’s torment, they would certainly cry, “Woe to us! We have really been wrongdoers.”

verses.arabicText: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wanaḍaʿu l-mawāzīna l-qis'ṭa liyawmi l-qiyāmati falā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayaw-wa-in kāna mith'qāla ḥabbatim-min khardalin ataynā bihā wakafā binā ḥāsibīn
verses.translation: We will set up the scales of justice on the Day of Judgment, so no soul will be wronged in the least. And ˹even˺ if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءًۭ وَذِكْرًۭا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā wahārūna l-fur'qāna waḍiyāaw-wadhik'ran lil'muttaqīn
verses.translation: Indeed, We granted Moses and Aaron the standard ˹to distinguish between right and wrong˺—a light and a reminder for the righteous

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum mina s-sāʿati mush'fiqūn
verses.translation: who are in awe of their Lord without seeing Him, and are fearful of the Hour

verses.arabicText: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wahādhā dhik'rum-mubārakun anzalnāhu afa-antum lahu munkirūn
verses.translation: And this ˹Quran˺ is a blessed reminder which We have revealed. Will you ˹pagans˺ then deny it

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ātaynā ib'rāhīma rush'dahu min qablu wakunnā bihi ʿālimīn
verses.translation: And indeed, We had granted Abraham sound judgment early on, for We knew him well ˹to be worthy of it˺

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā hādhihi t-tamāthīlu allatī antum lahā ʿākifūn
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he questioned his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū wajadnā ābāanā lahā ʿābidīn
verses.translation: They replied, “We found our forefathers worshipping them.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qāla laqad kuntum antum waābāukum fī ḍalālim-mubīnin
verses.translation: He responded, “Indeed, you and your forefathers have been clearly astray.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū aji'tanā bil-ḥaqi am anta mina l-lāʿibīn
verses.translation: They asked, “Have you come to us with the truth, or is this a joke?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla bal rabbukum rabbu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi alladhī faṭarahunna wa-anā ʿalā dhālikum mina sh-shāhidīn
verses.translation: He replied, “In fact, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them ˹both˺. And to that I bear witness.”

verses.arabicText: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Watal-lahi la-akīdanna aṣnāmakum baʿda an tuwallū mud'birīn
verses.translation: ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “By Allah! I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned your backs and gone away.”

verses.arabicText: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًۭا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fajaʿalahum judhādhan illā kabīral-lahum laʿallahum ilayhi yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: So he smashed them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so they might turn to it ˹for answers˺

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū man faʿala hādhā biālihatinā innahu lamina ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: They protested, “Who dared do this to our gods? It must be an evildoer!”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًۭى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qālū samiʿ'nā fatay-yadhkuruhum yuqālu lahu ib'rāhīm
verses.translation: Some said, “We heard a young man, called Abraham, speaking ˹ill˺ of them.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū fatū bihi ʿalā aʿyuni n-nāsi laʿallahum yashhadūn
verses.translation: They demanded, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness ˹his trial˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qālū a-anta faʿalta hādhā biālihatinā yāib'rāhīm
verses.translation: They asked, “Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā fasalūhum in kānū yanṭiqūn
verses.translation: He replied ˹sarcastically˺, “No, this one—the biggest of them—did it! So ask them, if they can talk!”

verses.arabicText: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Farajaʿū ilā anfusihim faqālū innakum antumu ẓ-ẓālimūn
verses.translation: So they came back to their senses, saying ˹to one another˺, “You yourselves are truly the wrongdoers!”

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma nukisū ʿalā ruūsihim laqad ʿalim'ta mā hāulāi yanṭiqūn
verses.translation: Then they ˹quickly˺ regressed to their ˹original˺ mind-set, ˹arguing,˺ “You already know that those ˹idols˺ cannot talk.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
verses.transliteration: Qāla afataʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayaw-walā yaḍurrukum
verses.translation: He rebuked ˹them˺, “Do you then worship—instead of Allah—what can neither benefit nor harm you in any way

verses.arabicText: أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Uffil-lakum walimā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi afalā taʿqilūn
verses.translation: Shame on you and whatever you worship instead of Allah! Do you not have any sense?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū ḥarriqūhu wa-unṣurū ālihatakum in kuntum fāʿilīn
verses.translation: They concluded, “Burn him up to avenge your gods, if you must act.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Qul'nā yānāru kūnī bardaw-wasalāman ʿalā ib'rāhīm
verses.translation: We ordered, “O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!”

verses.arabicText: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-akhsarīn
verses.translation: They had sought to harm him, but We made them the worst losers

verses.arabicText: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wanajjaynāhu walūṭan ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā lil'ʿālamīn
verses.translation: Then We delivered him, along with Lot, to the land We had showered with blessings for all people

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةًۭ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilataw-wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīn
verses.translation: And We blessed him with Isaac ˹as a son˺ and Jacob ˹as a grandson˺, as an additional favour—making all of them righteous

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalnāhum a-immatay-yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma ṣ-ṣalati waītāa z-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīn
verses.translation: We ˹also˺ made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and inspired them to do good deeds, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. And they were devoted to Our worship

verses.arabicText: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'maw-waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīn
verses.translation: And to Lot We gave wisdom and knowledge, and delivered him from the society engrossed in shameful practices. They were certainly an evil, rebellious people

verses.arabicText: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina ṣ-ṣāliḥīn
verses.translation: And We admitted him into Our mercy, ˹for˺ he was truly one of the righteous

verses.arabicText: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīm
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Noah had cried out to Us earlier, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great distress

verses.arabicText: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: And We made him prevail over those who had rejected Our signs. They were truly an evil people, so We drowned them all

verses.arabicText: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīn
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when David and Solomon passed judgment regarding the crops ruined ˹at night˺ by someone’s sheep, and We were witness to their judgments

verses.arabicText: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'maw-waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīn
verses.translation: We guided ˹young˺ Solomon to a fairer settlement, and granted each of them wisdom and knowledge. We subjected the mountains as well as the birds to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with David. It is We Who did ˹it all˺

verses.arabicText: وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsil-lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūn
verses.translation: We taught him the art of making body armour to protect you in battle. Will you then be grateful

verses.arabicText: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walisulaymāna r-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīn
verses.translation: And to Solomon We subjected the raging winds, blowing by his command to the land We had showered with blessings. It is We Who know everything

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamina sh-shayāṭīni may-yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīn
verses.translation: And ˹We subjected˺ some jinn that dived for him, and performed other duties. It is We Who kept them in check

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya ḍ-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu r-rāḥimīn
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Job cried out to his Lord, “I have been touched with adversity, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰبِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurriw-waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatam-min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīn
verses.translation: So We answered his prayer and removed his adversity, and gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for the ˹devoted˺ worshippers

verses.arabicText: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullum-mina ṣ-ṣābirīn
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ Ishmael, Enoch, and Ⱬul-Kifl. They were all steadfast

verses.arabicText: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina ṣ-ṣāliḥīn
verses.translation: We admitted them into Our mercy, for they were truly of the righteous

verses.arabicText: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًۭا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wadhā n-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna al-lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī ẓ-ẓulumāti al-lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when the Man of the Whale stormed off ˹from his city˺ in a rage, thinking We would not restrain him. Then in the ˹veils of˺ darkness he cried out, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from anguish. And so do We save the ˹true˺ believers

verses.arabicText: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardaw-wa-anta khayru l-wārithīn
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Zachariah cried out to his Lord, “My Lord! Do not leave me childless, though You are the Best of Successors.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًۭا وَرَهَبًۭا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghabaw-warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīn
verses.translation: So We answered his prayer, granted him John, and made his wife fertile. Indeed, they used to race in doing good, and call upon Us with hope and fear, totally humbling themselves before Us

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā mir-rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatal-lil'ʿālamīn
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ the one who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her through Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ making her and her son a sign for all peoples

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhihi ummatukum ummataw-wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūn
verses.translation: ˹O prophets!˺ Indeed, this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so worship Me ˹alone˺

verses.arabicText: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynā rājiʿūn
verses.translation: Yet the people have divided it into sects. But to Us they will all return

verses.arabicText: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Famay-yaʿmal mina ṣ-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā kuf'rāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūn
verses.translation: So whoever does good and is a believer will never be denied ˹the reward for˺ their striving, for We are recording it all

verses.arabicText: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: It is impossible for a society which We have destroyed to ever rise again

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍۢ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā futiḥat yajūju wamajūju wahum min kulli ḥadabiy-yansilūn
verses.translation: until ˹after˺ Gog and Magog have broken loose ˹from the barrier˺, swarming down from every hill

verses.arabicText: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-iq'taraba l-waʿdu l-ḥaqu fa-idhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣāru alladhīna kafarū yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatim-min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīn
verses.translation: ushering in the True Promise. Then—behold!—the disbelievers will stare ˹in horror, crying,˺ “Oh, woe to us! We have truly been heedless of this. In fact, we have been wrongdoers.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi ḥaṣabu jahannama antum lahā wāridūn
verses.translation: Certainly you ˹disbelievers˺ and whatever you worship instead of Allah will be the fuel of Hell. You are ˹all˺ bound to enter it

verses.arabicText: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةًۭ مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Law kāna hāulāi ālihatam-mā waradūhā wakullun fīhā khālidūn
verses.translation: Had those idols been ˹true˺ gods, they would not have entered it. And they will be there forever

verses.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌۭ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lahum fīhā zafīruw-wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūn
verses.translation: In it they will groan, and will not be able to hear

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna sabaqat lahum minnā l-ḥus'nā ulāika ʿanhā mub'ʿadūn
verses.translation: Surely those for whom We have destined the finest reward will be kept far away from Hell

verses.arabicText: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā wahum fī mā ish'tahat anfusuhum khālidūn
verses.translation: not even hearing the slightest hissing from it. And they will delight forever in what their souls desire

verses.arabicText: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yaḥzunuhumu l-fazaʿu l-akbaru watatalaqqāhumu l-malāikatu hādhā yawmukumu alladhī kuntum tūʿadūn
verses.translation: The Supreme Horror ˹of that Day˺ will not disturb them, and the angels will greet them, ˹saying,˺ “This is your Day, which you have been promised.”

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍۢ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma naṭwī s-samāa kaṭayyi s-sijili lil'kutubi kamā badanā awwala khalqin-nuʿīduhu waʿdan ʿalaynā innā kunnā fāʿilīn
verses.translation: On that Day We will roll up the heavens like a scroll of writings. Just as We produced the first creation, ˹so˺ shall We reproduce it. That is a promise binding on Us. We truly uphold ˹Our promises˺

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad katabnā fī z-zabūri min baʿdi dh-dhik'ri anna l-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiya ṣ-ṣāliḥūn
verses.translation: Surely, following the ˹heavenly˺ Record, We decreed in the Scriptures: “My righteous servants shall inherit the land.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغًۭا لِّقَوْمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī hādhā labalāghal-liqawmin ʿābidīn
verses.translation: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is sufficient ˹as a reminder˺ for those devoted to worship

verses.arabicText: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatal-lil'ʿālamīn
verses.translation: We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a mercy for the whole world

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhuw-wāḥidun fahal antum mus'limūn
verses.translation: Say, “What has been revealed to me is this: ‘Your God is only One God.’ Will you then submit?”

verses.arabicText: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۢ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-in tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāiw-wa-in adrī aqarībun am baʿīdum-mā tūʿadūn
verses.translation: If they turn away, then say, “I have warned you all equally. I do not know if what you are threatened with is near or far

verses.arabicText: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra mina l-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūn
verses.translation: Allah surely knows what you say openly and whatever you hide

verses.arabicText: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-in adrī laʿallahu fit'natul-lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin
verses.translation: I do not know if this ˹delay˺ is possibly a test for you and an enjoyment for a while.”

verses.arabicText: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi uḥ'kum bil-ḥaqi warabbunā r-raḥmānu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūn
verses.translation: ˹In the end,˺ the Prophet said, “My Lord! Judge ˹between us˺ in truth. And our Lord is the Most Compassionate, Whose help is sought against what you claim.”
